paper: FINRS: A Risk-Sensitive Trading Framework for Real Financial Markets
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock implementation of FINRS's hierarchical market analysis, position-aware dual decisions, delayed multi-scale reflection, scaled Kelly, CVaR, volatility adjustment, and account exposure; not an independent regeneration of the paper's FinPos-reused results.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: FINRS combines hierarchical market perception, separate direction and quantity/risk decisions, and multi-scale reward reflection to align positions with return and downside constraints.
The Quantity/Risk Agent jointly references scaled Kelly sizing, CVaR, current account exposure, and volatility adjustment after a direction has been chosen.
Positions carry forward as prior position plus direction times quantity, while future 1/7/30-day trends are restricted to training-time reflection.
Risk-Sensitive Reasoning is the defining addition beyond Financial Insight Prompting, Market News Integration, and Multi-Timescale Reward.

risk_sensitive_policy.base_position_policy: the frozen M039 FinPos in-spirit direction, reflection, carried-position, and CVaR logic
risk_sensitive_policy.kelly_probability: 0.50 plus 0.25 times absolute base carried-position confidence
risk_sensitive_policy.kelly_payoff_odds: mean positive return divided by absolute mean negative return over the preceding 20 stock months, clipped to 0.5 through 2.0
risk_sensitive_policy.volatility_adjustment: one divided by one plus stock 20-month volatility divided by the current cross-sectional median volatility
risk_sensitive_policy.risk_sensitive_target: sign of base position times the minimum of base absolute position, scaled Kelly times volatility adjustment, CVaR cap, and 0.75
risk_sensitive_policy.missing_signal_rule: carry the prior valid position under missing current analysis, inherited from the base position policy
risk_sensitive_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the risk-sensitive carried-position score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

approximated_elements: the frozen FinPos in-spirit policy supplies the shared hierarchical analysis and direction base
position magnitude supplies a deterministic direction-confidence proxy
rolling positive/negative realized returns supply Kelly payoff odds
monthly 20-period volatility and CVaR replace unspecified daily estimators
continuous normalized exposure replaces integer shares
a fixed 0.75 exposure ceiling replaces missing account constraints
the common decile portfolio replaces the five-stock daily account ledger
invented_elements: the exact signed JKP memory features
the Kelly probability mapping and clipped payoff odds
